reason: As someone who remembers the refunds and has already given elsewhere this month, B answers my actual worries: my pledge comes back in full if it falls short, $11,000 is already committed in writing so only $49,000 is left, there's a reopening date, public spending reports, and a named person accountable. A leaves a "[Bank name]" blank, never says what happens to my money if it fails, and its "$10 per resident" line feels like pressure rather than reassurance.
